provenance.gyro_noise_dps: measured: max-axis Allan N * sqrt(200.00 Hz) (per-sample std at the measured rate)
provenance.gyro_bias_dps: measured: |mean gyro vector| over the stationary record (one power cycle; incl. Earth rate)
provenance.accel_noise_mg: measured: max-axis Allan N * sqrt(200.00 Hz)
